title: SaaS order form that never mentions renewal
notes: Renewal is not addressed, so auto_renew must be null; guessing false is the critical error. The thirty-day payment term is not a cancellation notice.

clauses.span: each party's total liability arising out of or relating to this Order shall not exceed the fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim
Fees are non-refundable except as expressly stated in these terms.
Provider may suspend access if an invoice remains unpaid after Provider has sent a written reminder.
